correctness.rationale: Every pole of the scroll projector has nonzero matrix residue, and rank-d projectors linearly span the space of symmetric matrices; therefore generic projector-valued data does not cancel any pole. The nonzero first jet at infinity and Riemann--Hurwitz yield exactly 2deg(lcm)-2 zeros of the derivative. The hyperplane-incidence scheme is generically reduced: for general real t, P_prime(t) is real symmetric with eigenvalue zero of multiplicity m-2d and remaining eigenspaces of dimension at most d; its commuting-projector locus has codimension >=d(d+1). Generic smoothness over characteristic zero ensures distinct critical points. Exact checker passed five samples (multidegrees (2,3), (2,4), (3,5), (2,2,3), (2,3,4)).
